sampling_notes.corpus_totals_disclosure: Total records in omni_corpus.csv: 453,878 (Amazon: 393,890, Flipkart: 15,000, Yelp: 25,000, IMDb: 19,988). The held-out multi-domain test set (omni_heldout_multidomain_test.csv) contains 6,000 separate records (2,000 each Yelp, IMDb, Flipkart; zero overlap with corpus). Total across both files is 459,878.
sampling_notes.imdb_exact_n: IMDb source had 25,000 train rows in HuggingFace. 2,000 were held out into omni_heldout_multidomain_test.csv, leaving 20,000 requested for omni_corpus.csv; exactly 12 whitespace/empty text rows were dropped during normalization, resulting in 19,988 records.
sampling_notes.replay_buffer_partition: Inside omni_corpus.csv, replay buffer consists of 15,957 Yelp rows, 16,068 IMDb rows, and 10,165 synthetic Flipkart rows. Held-out test rows sit in omni_heldout_multidomain_test.csv with zero training overlap.
sampling_notes.flipkart_synthetic_disclosure: Flipkart data (15,000 rows in corpus, 10,165 binary in training replay) was synthesized via combinatorial template fallbacks (_generate_synthetic_flipkart) when external servers were unreachable. Real-review multi-platform replay consists solely of Yelp (15,957) + IMDb (16,068) = 32,025 reviews (9.90% of training blend).
sampling_notes.yelp_polarity_balance: Yelp Dining sample reflects balanced polarity: 10,015 negative vs 9,935 positive (50.2% / 49.8% binary split), with 5,050 3-star neutral reviews separated.
